text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With the Takarazuka Kinen still looking unlikely, a dismal mood has fallen over the racing world.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Don't worry, Big Brother. I'm okay.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Don't worry, Big Sister. I'm okay.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: So she says, but her smile looks empty. It must still be bothering her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Buzz… buzz…

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: S-sorry! I have to go!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: S-sorry! I have to go!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Not far!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Where in the world could Rice Shower be going?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: …Was that Rice Shower that just ran by?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: I-I think so. She looked really intense. You don't think—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: S-stop! She's always working so hard, so don't…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I race up the stairs. Please tell me this pit in the bottom of my stomach is totally unfounded!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Please… ask them to let us use the course!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I tear across the corridor toward her voice.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Patience! There are certain procedures that must be followed before I—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: But I've already asked the Hanshin staff! And the Kyoto staff too!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: So please… save the Takarazuka Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Astonishment! Now Trainer <username> is here too?!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Big Brother?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Big Sister?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: …I came to ask the director for something.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I was thinking we could hold the Takarazuka Kinen at the Kyoto Racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Indeed! She asked just last night as well, if memory serves.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Alas! It is not my decision to make. We must first contact—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: B-but I told you—I've already contacted the Hanshin and Kyoto Racecourses!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Sorry to cause you trouble, and I know it's not easy, but please help us!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Please, please, please! I want to do everything I possibly can for all the people who have supported me up until now!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Huh?! N-now, now… Let's all calm dow—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: S-sorry for the delay! I have good news!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Tazuna! My savior!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: This year's Takarazuka Kinen will be held at the Kyoto Racecourse!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Really?!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Yes. Both the Hanshin and Kyoto Racecourses' staff have been talking to each other behind the scenes. They're determined to make it happen.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: They're giving it their all for this race… and for you, Rice Shower.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Hic… I'm so glad… that they're holding the race.
choice_data_list: Now it's your turn to work hard.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Yeah… Yeah! Not just for me, but for everyone who's working hard to make this happen.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: And for everyone who's supported me!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I'm going to run in the Takarazuka Kinen… and make everyone smile!
